qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct.independent_information_content: High physical validity: measures single-lap machinery ceiling.
qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct.collinearity_with_grid: Spearman rho = 0.884 with grid position (high collinearity).
qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct.status: QUALIFIED FOR MODEL C ABLATION (Strictly with has_valid_time indicator)
qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct.conditions: Must be evaluated against Empirical Grid Baseline; must handle missingness without artificial numbers.

sector_pace_delta.independent_information_content: Redundant when full qualifying lap time is present (r > 0.98).
sector_pace_delta.collinearity_verdict: DUPLICATIVE of qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct. Does not provide orthogonal signal.

sprint_race_pace_indicator.provenance: Saturday 100km sprint race median green-flag lap pace
sprint_race_pace_indicator.data_completeness_pct: 98.9% on Sprint weekends (6 races); 0% on Standard weekends (18 races)
sprint_race_pace_indicator.independent_information_content: High orthogonal validity: measures actual racecraft, tyre management, and race trim under Parc Fermé.
sprint_race_pace_indicator.collinearity_with_qualifying: Moderate (rho ~ 0.55), provides genuinely distinct race-pace signal.
sprint_race_pace_indicator.conditions: Strict temporal separation: available ONLY at Stage S2/S3 (post-sprint), NEVER at Stage S1.

qualifying_vs_sector_pace_correlation.conclusion: Sector pace delta is virtually collinear with full qualifying lap delta. Including both in a linear model creates multicollinearity with zero incremental gain.
